hints.shopId: Taken from your YooKassa dashboard, next to the secret key.
hints.secretKey: Issued in your YooKassa dashboard. Stored encrypted and never sent back to the browser.
hints.capture: On: one-stage payment, the money is debited right away. Off: two-stage payment, the amount is held and you capture it later.
hints.paymentDescription: Used when the checkout context doesn't provide one. Up to 128 characters, shown to the customer during payment and in your YooKassa dashboard.
hints.useReceipt: Sends receipt data with every payment so it can be registered under 54-FZ.
hints.useAtolOnlineFFD120: Turn on if an Atol Online sales register on FFD 1.2 registers the receipts. It makes the tax system required.
hints.taxSystemCode: Applies to the whole receipt. Items under different tax systems have to be sent in separate receipts.
hints.taxItemDefault: The rate applied to every product line of the receipt.
hints.taxShippingDefault: The rate applied to the shipping line of the receipt.
